title: Skill practice — Lasix drip titration + labs (Tele)
disclaimer: All patients, orders, and events in this pack are fictional and for educational practice only.
learningObjectives: Start and verify a continuous furosemide (Lasix) drip for acute decompensated HF
Titrate the drip using urine output, blood pressure, and clinical volume response
Identify priority labs while on a loop diuretic drip (K, Mag, creatinine/BMP, BNP/weight trends)
Perform volume and telemetry assessments during aggressive diuresis
